svg.aria-label: Join types for pd.merge on customer_id. df_customers has ids 1, 2, 3 and 4; df_orders has ids 2, 1, 4 and 5. Ids 1, 2 and 4 are in both tables, 3 is only in df_customers and 5 is only in df_orders. An inner join keeps 1, 2 and 4 (3 rows); left keeps 1, 2, 3 and 4; right keeps 2, 1, 4 and 5; outer keeps all five. Where one side has no match, its columns are filled with NaN.
svg.title: merge join types
